name: Global Indian International School
summary: Indian and international curricula across multiple Singapore campuses.
body: GIIS serves Indian and broader international families with CBSE / other pathways depending on campus. Multiple sites mean geography and curriculum stream must be chosen together. A common shortlist for Indian corporate and diaspora families. Cohort birthday density rises mid-term — dual-career families should cap guest lists early and align with school communication norms on party invites. Weekday parent coffee mornings and academy waits still need dual-career calendar owners — ask admissions how early morning parent events are scheduled against bus routes.
